### Sin Never Keeps Its Promises
Author: Stephen Witmer
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/sin-never-keeps-its-promises
Passage: Isaiah 20:1-6
Points:
- Sin swindles us with sweet lies, but trusting anything other than God always ends in shame.
- God commanded Isaiah to walk stripped and barefoot for three years as a dramatic prophetic sign.
- Isaiah's visible vulnerability exposed Egypt's coming humiliation and captivity under Assyria.
- Judah was warned through this sign never to put their trust in worldly allies instead of the Lord.
- The prophet's willingness to endure public shame foreshadows Jesus bearing our ultimate shame on the cross.
